claims.gap: DIVERGENCE, pinned rather than asserted: overlap is AMPLIFIED, not preserved (alpha 0.25 -> ~0.50, 0.50 -> ~0.90 at beta=0.10), and raising beta to/past beta0=1.349 does not restore it. Every practical beta is far below beta0 -- including the papers' own beta=0.06 -- so the hypothesis is not in force and this is a divergence from the guarantee, not a refutation. See research/notes/kwta_amplifies_input_overlap.md

VACUOUS at every beta anyone runs (182k here, 506k at the acquisition paper's beta=0.06), so it is recorded and its vacuity asserted rather than the bound itself -- a bound nothing can violate is not a check.
